summary: Replacing 3..5 => true with 3..5 => false beside 1..3 => false leaves two adjacent equal-valued ranges because insertion considers only the last range starting at or before the new range. The fix considers the preceding touching range too and includes the starting boundary in the subsequent scan, allowing replacement and coalescing into 1..5 => false. The selected regression test was added by this fix. The reversal restores both implementation changes in src/map.rs verbatim; reproduction has not been run.
expected_failure:
assertion failed: `(left == right)`
  left: `[(1..3, false), (3..5, false)]`,
 right: `[(1..5, false)]`
